parameters.query: WITH params AS (SELECT now() AS run_at, date_trunc('day', now()) AS day_start, now() - interval '24 hours' AS since_24h, now() - interval '6 hours' AS stuck_before), data_intake AS (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM tracker_entries) AS tracker_entries_total, (SELECT count(*) FROM tracker_entries, params WHERE tracker_entries.created_at >= params.day_start) AS tracker_entries_today, (SELECT count(*) FROM tracker_entries, params WHERE tracker_entries.created_at >= params.since_24h) AS tracker_entries_last_24h, (SELECT count(*) FROM observations) AS observations_total, (SELECT count(*) FROM observations, params WHERE observations.created_at >= params.day_start) AS observations_today, (SELECT count(*) FROM research_signal_candidates) AS signal_candidates_total, (SELECT count(*) FROM research_signal_candidates, params WHERE research_signal_candidates.created_at >= params.day_start) AS signal_candidates_today), interview_funnel AS (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews) AS parent_interviews_total, (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews WHERE status = 'started') AS started, (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews WHERE status = 'in_progress') AS in_progress, (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews WHERE status = 'completed') AS completed, (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews WHERE status = 'abandoned') AS abandoned), stage_counts AS (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(stage_name, stage_count ORDER BY stage_order) AS active_conversations_by_stage FROM (SELECT v.stage_order, v.stage_name, count(c.conversation_id) AS stage_count FROM (VALUES (1,'new'),(2,'waiting_q1'),(3,'waiting_q2'),(4,'waiting_q3'),(5,'waiting_q4'),(6,'analysis'),(7,'completed')) AS v(stage_order, stage_name) LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.current_stage = v.stage_name AND c.status = 'active' GROUP BY v.stage_order, v.stage_name) s), top_today AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signal_name', signal_name, 'count', signal_count) ORDER BY signal_count DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS top_signal_name_today FROM (SELECT coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown') AS signal_name, count(*) AS signal_count FROM research_signal_candidates, params WHERE research_signal_candidates.created_at >= params.day_start GROUP BY coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown') ORDER BY signal_count DESC LIMIT 5) x), top_all AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signal_name', signal_name, 'count', signal_count) ORDER BY signal_count DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS top_signal_name_all_time FROM (SELECT coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown') AS signal_name, count(*) AS signal_count FROM research_signal_candidates GROUP BY coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown') ORDER BY signal_count DESC LIMIT 5) x), status_counts AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(status_name, status_count), '{}'::jsonb) AS candidate_status_counts FROM (SELECT coalesce(status, 'unknown') AS status_name, count(*) AS status_count FROM research_signal_candidates GROUP BY coalesce(status, 'unknown')) x), signal_summary AS (SELECT (SELECT top_signal_name_today FROM top_today) AS top_signal_name_today, (SELECT top_signal_name_all_time FROM top_all) AS top_signal_name_all_time, (SELECT round(avg(confidence)::numeric, 3) FROM research_signal_candidates WHERE confidence IS NOT NULL) AS average_confidence, (SELECT count(*) FROM research_signal_candidates WHERE confidence IS NOT NULL AND confidence < 0.5) AS low_confidence_count, (SELECT candidate_status_counts FROM status_counts) AS candidate_status_counts), bottlenecks AS (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM observations o LEFT JOIN research_signal_candidates r ON r.observation_id = o.observation_id WHERE r.candidate_id IS NULL) AS observations_without_signal_candidates, (SELECT count(*) FROM research_signal_candidates WHERE observation_id IS NULL) AS signal_candidates_without_observation_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM conversations, params WHERE status = 'active' AND current_stage IN ('new','waiting_q1','waiting_q2','waiting_q3','waiting_q4','analysis') AND coalesce(stage_updated_at, started_at) < params.stuck_before) AS conversations_stuck_over_6h, (SELECT count(*) FROM parent_interviews pi WHERE pi.status IN ('started','in_progress') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interview_responses ir WHERE ir.interview_id = pi.interview_id)) AS interviews_started_no_responses, (SELECT count(*) FROM conversation_events, params WHERE conversation_events.created_at >= params.day_start AND (event_type = 'error' OR event_payload::text ILIKE '%error%')) AS errors_today), repeated_themes AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('theme', signal_name, 'count', signal_count) ORDER BY signal_count DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS themes FROM (SELECT coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown') AS signal_name, count(*) AS signal_count FROM research_signal_candidates, params WHERE research_signal_candidates.created_at >= params.since_24h GROUP BY coalesce(signal_name, 'unknown') HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY signal_count DESC LIMIT 5) x) SELECT params.run_at, jsonb_build_object('tracker_entries_total', data_intake.tracker_entries_total, 'tracker_entries_today', data_intake.tracker_entries_today, 'tracker_entries_last_24h', data_intake.tracker_entries_last_24h, 'observations_total', data_intake.observations_total, 'observations_today', data_intake.observations_today, 'signal_candidates_total', data_intake.signal_candidates_total, 'signal_candidates_today', data_intake.signal_candidates_today) AS data_intake, jsonb_build_object('parent_interviews_total', interview_funnel.parent_interviews_total, 'started', interview_funnel.started, 'in_progress', interview_funnel.in_progress, 'completed', interview_funnel.completed, 'abandoned', interview_funnel.abandoned, 'active_conversations_by_stage', stage_counts.active_conversations_by_stage) AS interview_funnel, jsonb_build_object('top_signal_name_today', signal_summary.top_signal_name_today, 'top_signal_name_all_time', signal_summary.top_signal_name_all_time, 'average_confidence', signal_summary.average_confidence, 'low_confidence_count', signal_summary.low_confidence_count, 'candidate_status_counts', signal_summary.candidate_status_counts) AS signal_summary, jsonb_build_object('observations_without_signal_candidates', bottlenecks.observations_without_signal_candidates, 'signal_candidates_without_observation_id', bottlenecks.signal_candidates_without_observation_id, 'conversations_stuck_over_6h', bottlenecks.conversations_stuck_over_6h, 'interviews_started_no_responses', bottlenecks.interviews_started_no_responses, 'errors_today', bottlenecks.errors_today) AS bottlenecks, repeated_themes.themes AS repeated_themes FROM params CROSS JOIN data_intake CROSS JOIN interview_funnel CROSS JOIN stage_counts CROSS JOIN signal_summary CROSS JOIN bottlenecks CROSS JOIN repeated_themes;
